name: What are the typical phases of a retail construction project?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical phases of a retail construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A retail construction project typically begins with conceptual design and feasibility studies, followed by detailed architectural and engineering planning. Once designs are finalized and permits secured, the construction phase commences. This includes site preparation, foundation work, structural framing, exterior finishes, and interior build-out such as flooring, lighting, fixtures, and specialized equipment installation. The final stages involve quality inspections, commissioning, and client handover. Throughout, project management ensures adherence to timelines, budget, and design specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Retail construction phases generally include design, permitting, site preparation, structural build-out, interior finishing, and final inspections.
